newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up but off highs as stock losses pared.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up but off highs as stock losses pared.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Tuesday's Tokyo session slightly higher in dealer-led trade.
The March closed up 0.06 at 125.73. The volume was 42,823 contracts.
The key contract gave up earlier gains in the afternoon as Tokyo stocks had managed to climb back up from earlier lows, traders said.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares ended down 25.66 points, or 0.14 percent, at 18,093.13, after falling as low as 17,545.52.
